# CG-REQ-038: Request allOf constraint added

A non-mergeable allOf branch was added to a request schema.

**Why it matters:** A new conjunct can only narrow; its exact effect is not computed.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.variantAdded` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> A new allOf constraint applies to {where}.
>
> The constraint could not be merged and compared, so it may reject previously valid payloads.
>
> **Fix:** Review the new constraint.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: non-mergeable allOf branch added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {allOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Base'}, {minLength: 1}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {allOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Base'}, {minLength: 1}, {not: {const: x}}]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
  components:
    schemas:
      Base: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}]}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. A new allOf constraint applies to POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Does not fire: mergeable allOf

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {allOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Base'}, {properties: {x: {}}}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {}, x: {}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
- components:
-   schemas:
-     Base: {type: object, properties: {a: {}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
